newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
The last established price was $63.00 per cwt on Thursday. Monday's packer bids were $62.00-$63.00, with asking prices $64.00-$65.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
